feature: Refactor Wizard UI into Modular Components
description: Break down the large monolithic SetupWizard.tsx (~1000 lines) into smaller, reusable components with clear responsibilities. Improve state management boundaries and code organization for easier maintenance and contributor onboarding.

phases.name: Extract Wizard Shell Components
phases.description: Extract the wizard's structural/layout components from SetupWizard.tsx into dedicated files

subtasks.title: Create WizardHeader component
subtasks.description: Extract the header section with title, badge, and action buttons (Reset, Profiles, Tools) from SetupWizard.tsx into docs-site/src/components/wizard/WizardHeader.tsx
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted WizardHeader component from SetupWizard.tsx. Component includes title, sparkles badge, and action buttons (Reset, Profiles, Tools). Maintains reduced motion support and animation behavior. Reset confirmation state managed by parent component to allow form resets. Committed in 7df5faf.

subtasks.title: Create WizardProgressBar component
subtasks.description: Extract the progress bar and step counter ('Step X of Y - N% Complete') into docs-site/src/components/wizard/WizardProgressBar.tsx
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted WizardProgressBar component from SetupWizard.tsx. Component includes animated progress bar and step counter text ('Step X of Y - N% Complete'). Reads currentStep from store via selector. Respects reduced motion preferences. Accepts steps array as prop for calculating progress percentage. Committed in 67b4bbb.

subtasks.title: Create WizardStepIndicator component
subtasks.description: Extract the horizontal step indicator with clickable completed steps into docs-site/src/components/wizard/WizardStepIndicator.tsx
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted WizardStepIndicator component from SetupWizard.tsx. Component includes horizontal step indicator with clickable completed steps, step icons, animated connection lines between steps, and proper accessibility attributes. Uses store's setCurrentStep for navigation. Respects the existing visual design with green checkmarks for completed steps and pulse animation for current step. Committed in ba5c601.

subtasks.title: Create WizardNavigation component
subtasks.description: Extract the sticky bottom navigation bar with Back/Next buttons into docs-site/src/components/wizard/WizardNavigation.tsx
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted WizardNavigation component from SetupWizard.tsx. Component handles the sticky bottom navigation bar with Back/Next buttons, and conditional rendering for final step 'Start Over' button. Receives onNext, onPrev, and onReset handlers as props. Reads currentStep from store to determine which button to show on final step. Maintains existing styling with glass-ultra effect and btn-lift animations. Removed unused ArrowLeft/ArrowRight icon imports from SetupWizard.tsx. Committed in 7a843f9.

subtasks.title: Create barrel export for wizard components
subtasks.description: Create docs-site/src/components/wizard/index.ts barrel file to export all wizard components cleanly
subtasks.notes: Successfully created barrel file at docs-site/src/components/wizard/index.ts. Exports 4 wizard shell components (WizardHeader, WizardProgressBar, WizardStepIndicator, WizardNavigation) and 5 step components (QuickStartStep, StackSelectionStep, BasicConfigurationStep, AdvancedSettingsStep, ReviewGenerateStep). Follows the established pattern from docs/index.ts. Enables clean imports: import { WizardHeader } from '@/components/wizard'. Committed in f36c202.

phases.name: Extract Hooks and Utilities
phases.description: Move reusable logic from SetupWizard.tsx into custom hooks and utility modules

subtasks.title: Create useWizardAnimations hook
subtasks.description: Extract the animation variants (fadeInUp, scaleIn) that respect reduced motion preferences into docs-site/src/hooks/useWizardAnimations.ts
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted animation variants (fadeInUp, scaleIn) into docs-site/src/hooks/useWizardAnimations.ts. Hook uses useReducedMotion and returns memoized animation variants that respect reduced motion preferences. Follows existing hook patterns with proper JSDoc documentation. Committed in 7c36c29.

subtasks.title: Create useConfigGenerators hook
subtasks.description: Extract YAML/config generation logic (generateAutheliaYaml, generateCloudflareYaml) into docs-site/src/hooks/useConfigGenerators.ts
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted YAML/config generation logic (generateAutheliaYaml, generateCloudflareYaml) into docs-site/src/hooks/useConfigGenerators.ts. Hook reads config and selectedServices from store via selectors and returns memoized generator functions with proper dependency tracking. Functions generate Authelia SSO config and Cloudflare Tunnel ingress rules. SetupWizard.tsx updated to use the new hook. Committed in aa45900.

subtasks.title: Create useFileDownload hook
subtasks.description: Extract file download and clipboard utilities into docs-site/src/hooks/useFileDownload.ts
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted file download and clipboard utilities into docs-site/src/hooks/useFileDownload.ts. Hook includes copyToClipboard, downloadFile, downloadAllFiles, and generateEnvFile functions. Manages copied state internally with 2-second timeout. Functions properly memoized with useCallback and correct dependencies. Updated SetupWizard.tsx to use the new hook, removing inline implementations and unused imports. Follows established pattern from useConfigGenerators.ts. Committed in 3220c06.

subtasks.title: Create useWizardValidation hook
subtasks.description: Extract form validation and step navigation logic into docs-site/src/hooks/useWizardValidation.ts
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted form validation and step navigation logic into docs-site/src/hooks/useWizardValidation.ts. Hook handles handleNextStep logic including form validation for Basic Config (step 1) and Advanced Settings (step 4), manages shakeField state for error animations, scrolls to error fields with focus, and displays toast notifications. Includes scrollToElement and scrollToFirstError helper functions. Updated SetupWizard.tsx to use the new hook, reducing complexity by ~70 lines. Follows established pattern from useConfigGenerators and useFileDownload hooks. Committed in 176330f.

subtasks.title: Create useVoicePlanHandler hook
subtasks.description: Extract voice plan application logic (handleApplyVoicePlan) into docs-site/src/hooks/useVoicePlanHandler.ts
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted voice plan application logic (handleApplyVoicePlan) into docs-site/src/hooks/useVoicePlanHandler.ts. Hook handles applying voice companion suggestions to wizard state with undo support, including services, domain, and storage paths. Updated SetupWizard.tsx to use the new hook, removing ~50 lines of inline logic. Hook properly manages state updates via store selectors and provides onClose callback support for modal management. Removed unused imports (setSelectedServices, setCurrentStep, updateServiceConfig, updateStoragePath, VoicePlanSummary type) from SetupWizard.tsx. Follows established patterns from useConfigGenerators, useFileDownload, and useWizardValidation hooks with proper JSDoc documentation. Committed in 071c6fb.

Added to barrel export at docs-site/src/components/wizard/index.ts. Follows established pattern from DraftRecoveryModal with AnimatePresence wrapper. Committed in a460a97.

subtasks.title: Create ToolsDialog component

Follows established pattern from DraftRecoveryModal and ProfilesPanel with proper TypeScript interfaces and JSDoc documentation. Committed in 05d836c.

subtasks.title: Create VoiceCompanionTrigger component

Added to barrel export at docs-site/src/components/wizard/index.ts. Reduced SetupWizard.tsx by ~15 lines. Committed in 8aeb03f.
